name: Cloud Security
summary: In the cloud the blame is shared, but the bill is yours: understand the responsibility model and where the failures happen.
prerequisites: Requires cloud: the shared responsibility model assumes you know which half is yours.
syllabus: Cloud and on-premises: what changes for security
Identity and access: the new perimeter
Security of infrastructure as code and serverless
Logging, auditing and compliance in the cloud

topics.title: Differences between cloud and on-premises infrastructure
The shared responsibility model: what is yours and what is the provider’s
SaaS, PaaS and IaaS: where your share of the responsibility shifts
Multi-cloud and hybrid: the seams between providers, where control is thinnest
AWS, Google Cloud and Azure: equivalent services
Least privilege in practice: federation, SSO and the escalation path nobody revoked
Network isolation: private endpoints, egress control, and the subnet that reached the internet
Exposed storage: public buckets and the most common mistake of the decade
Personal storage at work: S3, OneDrive, Dropbox, Box, iCloud and Google Drive
Encryption at rest and in transit with managed keys
Infrastructure as code: secrets in the repository and reviewing the plan
Serverless security: function permissions and dependencies
The cloud deployment flow and quality gates
Logging and auditing: CloudTrail and its equivalents
Cloud security posture management (CSPM) and configuration scanning
